name: What is the process for starting a kitchen remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a kitchen remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and timeline for your kitchen remodel geared toward home sale. We'll assess your current kitchen, provide recommendations for maximizing ROI, and develop a detailed proposal. Once approved, we handle permit applications, material sourcing, and project management from start to finish, ensuring clear communication and a smooth execution through to the final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, proposal development, permit handling, material sourcing, project management, and a final walkthrough.
